channel.title: In the blink of an eye
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "In the blink of an eye" - What you see defines what you can do, what if you could see *much more*?

item.title: Re: In the blink of an eye
item.content:encoded:
Oh no! A critique! Hahahaha
Thanks for the review, friend.

I thought the Foundation would try doing this because they have the Samsara MTF but I am not overly attached to the idea that they have done it to her. I would do it this way just to explore the experiment itself but a Sarkic ritual works just as well. I wanted to avoid adding GoIs but in this case I feel like it is justified.

A drawback for her ability could be that she grows so much more interested and connected to her new reality that she starts to find it difficult to interact and relate to the "normal" reality. Maybe she starts being all "let's use my powers to help people!" and eventually she is "why would I use my powers to help people when there is much more in the universe?"
Kinda a Doctor Manhattan situation?

item.title: Re: In the blink of an eye
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via pm
Hello! Interesting SCP you've got there!
It would be a shame if someone…
Critiqued it…

+ show block
– hide block

Imma be honest..I kinda like this idea!
The only thing is I'm not sure if the Foundation would be the one too something like this. Combining humans with anomalous items seems something more like a Sarkic thing to do. Maybe the Agent gets left behind/capture during a raid on a Sarkic base, resulting in a ritual/experiment on her being performed that gives her those eyes? You can choose to keep/reject its idea, but just make sure it remains belivable.
My other concern is that the agent might become a bit omnipotent, so I think you should give some sort of consequence to her power and/or make them less strong. Maybe she starts to go insane or looses her free will/higher brain function, reducing her to little more than a mindless robot used by the foundation to do their dirty work.
I'm really close to greenlighting this. If you can just fix those two concerns, I'm more than willing to give you the go ahead. Best of luck, and please PM me if you want me to take another look!

item.title: In the blink of an eye
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP article/Personnel profile

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP page

Elevator Pitch:

  • Our senses define and limit how we interact with reality, they do not, however, define and limit reality itself. (aka there is more around us than meet the eye)
  • Human eyes can perceive three colors of light: red, blue and green, other colors are perceived by combining these three with the intensity of the light. Other animals have different light perception and therefore can see different colors than humans. Particularly, praying mantis shrimps can perceive between 12 and 16 light colors.
  • What happens when a human receives an experimental implant that allows them to see as many colors as a praying mantis shrimp?

Central Narrative: A high level MTF agent becomes blind after a mission and becomes the perfect guinea pig for an experimental biological implant that combines human and animal DNA to create augmented agents. The article starts with a brief description of the agent and how she lost her eyesight and how the implant was created. It follows with some logs regarding the surgery and recovery of the agent.

+ show block
– hide block

The meat of the narrative, though, is how her new eyes allow her to experience reality in a completely different way. Through personal entries on a journal she details her discoveries, they start small (new colors, night vision) and as she grows used to the new eyes they get bigger (she can see the flow of energy on living beings, see cracks and passages on reality that allow her to "teleport", see time as it passes, etc).

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

  • One goal here is create a new character to be used in future works on the wiki, she would make a great spy or extraction agent for example
  • Explore the growing sense of amazement and thrill someone feels when emerged on a new reality (aka my feelings when I discovered the SCP and plunged into this weird universe)
  • Expanding concepts such as the integrity of reality, time, space and other basic elements of the SCP universe and how humans and other beings interact with them

Additional Notes: None so far. Let the critiques begin!
